DDD 小品日常。

自從紅的戀人，紫回到工作室，本來感情升溫的紅和金，瞬間又退了回去，更況且，在紫的房間整理出來前，紫還睡在紅的房間。

金無聊的坐在起居室玩電動。
紅看到她。她看了看門口，知道紫今天一早就和黑出去談案子。

「金。」紅在她身邊坐了下來。

「嗯？」金依然專注在畫面上。
「啊～輸掉了啦。」

/
紅突然抱住金。
「紅？怎麼了？紫欺負妳？」金一愣，連忙丟掉遊戲手把，輕輕扶著紅。

/
「...」紅沒有說話。
金不知道如何是好。

ChatGPT
The DDD studio had been unusually quiet lately.

Ever since L.Night had returned to the studio, whatever strange little momentum had been building between D.Golden and E.Red had quietly collapsed. And with L.Night still sleeping in E.Red's room until her own space was ready, there wasn't exactly much room left for private moments.

So D.Golden had retreated to the living room.

She sat on the couch with a game controller in hand, staring intensely at the screen.

"Come on... come on..."

Her character missed the final attack.

"Nooo—! I lost!"

D.Golden dropped the controller onto her lap and leaned back with a frustrated sigh.

Then she noticed E.Red standing nearby.

E.Red glanced toward the entrance. L.Night had left early that morning with D.Dark to discuss a case, which meant the studio was finally free of its usual source of interruption.

She looked back at D.Golden.

"D.Golden."

"Hm?"

D.Golden barely looked away from the screen.

E.Red walked over and sat beside her.

D.Golden picked up the controller again.

"One more round."

E.Red said nothing.

Instead, she suddenly leaned over and wrapped her arms around D.Golden.

D.Golden froze.

"...E.Red?"

The controller slipped from her hands.

She quickly turned toward E.Red, her expression changing from confusion to concern.

"What happened? Did L.Night bully you?"

E.Red didn't answer.

D.Golden awkwardly put an arm around her.

"Hey..."

Still nothing.

D.Golden glanced toward the doorway.

Then back at E.Red.

Her usual straightforward confidence vanished almost instantly.

"...Are you okay?"

E.Red simply held on tighter.

D.Golden's ears slowly turned red.

'What am I supposed to do now...?'

She hesitated, then gently patted E.Red's back.

"It's okay."

A pause.

"You can stay like this."

E.Red finally murmured against her shoulder.

"...Just for a little while."

D.Golden swallowed.

"Yeah."

Another pause.

"...A little while."

紅的嘴角微微勾起，自從紫回來，她和金上一次這樣親近，已經不知道多久了。

「最近金跟白姐還好嗎？」紅沒有抬頭。
！N.White

「什、什麼還好？自從黑回來，我哪敢靠近白姐。」金支支吾吾。

全工作室都知道她對白的憧憬和仰慕。

「...那，金不會很可憐嗎？」

「可、可憐？」

「嗯...紫跟黑都在的時候。」

金一愣。
「哼！我有電玩呀，沒什麼吧？這種事情。」
「但是，紫那小子要是欺負紅，一定要告訴我，幫妳修理她！」金挺起胸。

/
紅忍不住笑出聲。
「金。...」
「怎麼了？」
紅往上挪動身子，注視她的臉龐。
一個吻很快落下。

金停住了動作。
在紫回來前，她們本來就快要在一起。
但...紅跟紫在一起過，現在顯然又再一次..

金接下了她的吻。

/
此刻，門鎖轉動的聲音。
「所以，明白剛剛那場的重點了？」黑的聲音。
「知道了，老大。」紫。
二人的視線才剛落在起居室。

/
紅似乎故意拉近金，不讓她『裝沒事』。
黑輕輕挑眉，對紫使了一個玩味的眼神，逕自走向白的房間。

紫也沒說話，輕輕咳了兩聲，默默回去紅的房間。

一段時間後，紅才放過金。

金眨著眼冷冷地看紅。

「紫在我房間沒錯。」
「但妳如果想找我聊天，我可以去金的房間。...」她靠在金的身上。

金愣愣地還沒想通過來。

ChatGPT
The smile at the corner of E.Red's lips grew slightly.

Ever since L.Night had returned, she couldn't even remember how long it had been since she and D.Golden had been this close.

"How are things between you and N.White lately?"

She didn't lift her head.

"W-What do you mean, how are things?" D.Golden stammered. "Ever since D.Dark came back, how could I even get close to N.White?"

Everyone in the studio knew how much D.Golden admired N.White.

E.Red was quiet for a moment.

"...Then doesn't D.Golden feel a little lonely?"

"L-Lonely?"

"Mm..." E.Red's voice was soft. "Whenever L.Night and D.Dark are both around."

D.Golden blinked.

"Hmph! I have video games. It's not like I have nothing to do."

Then she suddenly straightened, puffing out her chest.

"But if that L.Night ever bullies you, you have to tell me! I'll deal with her for you!"

E.Red couldn't hold back her laughter.

"D.Golden..."

"What?"

E.Red shifted upward, lifting her head until she could look directly at D.Golden.

Before D.Golden could react, E.Red leaned in.

A quick kiss landed on her lips.

D.Golden stopped moving.

For a second, she simply stared.

Before L.Night returned, the two of them had already been getting dangerously close to becoming something more.

But E.Red had ended up with L.Night.

And now...

Apparently, they were back here again.

D.Golden slowly closed her eyes and accepted the kiss.

Then—

The lock on the front door turned.

"So, you understand the important part of what happened in that last meeting?"

D.Dark's voice.

"Yeah. Got it, boss."

L.Night.

The two women stepped inside.

Their eyes had barely reached the living room when they saw the scene.

E.Red seemed to deliberately pull D.Golden a little closer, making it impossible for her to pretend that nothing had happened.

D.Dark raised an eyebrow.

She gave L.Night a knowing, almost amused look, then walked straight toward N.White's room.

L.Night said nothing.

She simply cleared her throat twice.

"...Ahem."

Then she quietly headed back to E.Red's room.

Some time passed before E.Red finally let D.Golden go.

D.Golden blinked a few times.

Then she slowly turned her head and gave E.Red a cool, almost suspicious look.

"So L.Night is staying in my room. Fine."

E.Red leaned against her.

"But if you want to talk to me, I can go to D.Golden's room..."

She rested her head comfortably against D.Golden's shoulder.

D.Golden froze.

Her brain completely stopped processing.

'...What?'

She stared straight ahead, still trying to figure out what E.Red had just said.

"...Wait."

She glanced down at E.Red.

"...Did you just say you'll come to my room?"
